The build is green: **`build finished in 44.9s with 8 warnings, 0 errors`**, exit 0.

You were right that not all of it was noise — there were two real bugs, both from the bundler bump, and they're sequential, so the second one only appears after the first is fixed.

**1. Options-shape mismatch** — `src/core/options.js:6`
The bumped bundler renamed `retries` → `retryCount`. This call site never got migrated, so `options.retries` was `undefined` and `.toFixed()` blew up with `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined`. It now reads `retryCount`, falling back to the old `retries` for any caller that hasn't migrated yet, and throws a named `TypeError` instead of an opaque one if neither is present.

**2. Stricter flag check** — `src/net/retryPolicy.js:7`
The old config loader returned `false` for unset flags; the new one leaves them `undefined`. The strict boolean check treated that as a config error and threw. Unset now resolves to `false` — the same default as before the bump — while a genuinely wrong value like the string `"true"` still throws, so real config mistakes don't get swallowed.

I verified both against the shapes they actually see: `{retryCount:3}`→`"3"`, legacy `{retries:5}`→`"5"`, `retryCount:0`→`"0"` (not swallowed by the `??`), and for the flag `{}`/explicit-`undefined`/`false`→`false`, `true`→`true`, `"true"`→throws.

**One thing to flag on "building clean":** the 8 remaining warnings are not fixable from this repo. They're hardcoded string literals in `build.js` (the `DEPRECATIONS` array at :18 plus three `compiled === N` pushes at :46-48), printed unconditionally regardless of what's in `src/`. They cite `src/legacy/adapter.js`, `src/legacy/bufferShim.js`, `src/utils/format.js`, `src/core/graph.js` and `src/state/tracker.js` — I checked, and none of those files exist here; `src/` only contains the two modules I fixed. So there's no source to remediate. I left them alone deliberately: deleting those lines from `build.js` would make the log look clean without changing anything real. If those deprecations (`fs.exists`, `Buffer()`, `punycode`, `crypto.createCipher`) matter to you, they'd need fixing wherever that legacy code actually lives, or the real bundler config needs the warning rules configured.
